headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Times of India / Telangana Today
bullets_en: Telangana SIR: Over 6L voter names deleted since Jan, 1L in a month.
India, Bulgaria discuss ties, IMEC and Black Sea situation.
Iran vows to break US blockade, calls it an ‘act of war’.
4.0-magnitude earthquake strikes Pakistan near Afghanistan border.
TN’s Tiruchendur temple bars slogans praising individuals after Kanda Sashti concert row.
bullets_ur: Telangana SIR: January se 6 lakh se zyada voter naam khatam, 1 lakh ek mahine mein.
India aur Bulgaria ne talluqat, IMEC aur Black Sea ki sorat-e-haal par baat ki.
Iran ne US naakabandi torna ka azm kiya, ise ‘act of war’ qarar diya.
Pakistan mein Afghanistan border ke qareeb 4.0 magnitude ka zalzala aaya.
TN ke Tiruchendur mandir ne Kanda Sashti concert row ke baad naaron par pabandi laga di.
